rows.prompt: Which agencies help Indian B2B SaaS companies set up cold email outreach, including deliverability and lead targeting? Please name up to five suitable agencies, give a short reason for each, and cite the sources you used. If you cannot verify an agency, say so.
rows.answer:
When scaling a B2B SaaS pipeline through cold email, partnering with a specialized outbound agency helps manage complex technical parameters—such as secondary domain provisioning, strict inbox warm-ups, SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, and precise Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) lead targeting.

Based on current industry research and market tracking for agencies operating in or catering to the Indian B2B tech ecosystem, here are five suitable agencies:

1. Modern Inbound

Short Reason: Run specifically with a focus on tech and software startups, this agency handles hands-off, research-led cold email outreach. They explicitly provision separate sending domains, implement 14-day mailbox warm-ups, and focus on hyper-personalized sequence writing tailored for B2B SaaS teams (Modern Inbound, 2026).

Source Used: Modern Inbound. (2026). Best Cold Email Agencies in India (2026): Prices & Fit. https://moderninbound.com/blog/best-cold-outreach-agencies-in-india

2. Leadle

Short Reason: Founded in 2016 and based in Chennai, Leadle specializes in signal-led outbound combined with Revenue Operations (RevOps). They construct targeted prospecting and technical infrastructure setups tailored for growth-stage B2B SaaS companies, allowing internal teams to either take over the system later or run it as a managed service (Modern Inbound, 2026; SalesCaptain, 2026).

Source Used: SalesCaptain. (2026). Top Cold Outreach Agencies in India. https://www.salescaptain.io/cold-outreach-agencies/best-cold-outreach-agencies-in-india; Modern Inbound. (2026). Best Cold Email Agencies in India (2026): Prices & Fit. https://moderninbound.com/blog/best-cold-outreach-agencies-in-india

3. Kology

Short Reason: Kology provides end-to-end B2B cold email lead generation with a heavy emphasis on technical infrastructure. Their scope specifically covers manual lead list research, 3-step email verification, and precise deliverability configuration including technical domain setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and automated mailbox warm-up (Kology, 2026).

Source Used: Kology. (2026). Cold Email Outreach Services | B2B Email Lead Gen. https://www.kology.co/cold-email-outreach-services/

4. SalesAladin

Short Reason: Operating out of the Delhi NCR region, SalesAladin builds targeted outbound systems for tech and B2B product companies. They assist with data enrichment, multi-channel or email-centric sequence mapping, and aligning messaging with specific software buyer personas.

Source Used: Modern Inbound. (2026). Best Cold Email Agencies in India (2026): Prices & Fit. https://moderninbound.com/blog/best-cold-outreach-agencies-in-india

5. Blueberg

Short Reason: Blueberg manages end-to-end B2B lead generation systems that feature explicit deliverability architecture. They configure secondary domains and inboxes, run domain warm-ups, monitor sending volumes, handle SPF/DKIM compliance, and treat ICP mapping as an iterative testing framework rather than a static brief (Blueberg, 2026).

Source Used: Blueberg. (2026). B2B Lead Generation Services. https://www.blueberg.in/lead-gen

Verification Note

While these agencies publicly document services covering cold email infrastructure, deliverability configuration, and B2B lead targeting, B2B SaaS companies should always request verifiable case studies involving similar Average Contract Values (ACVs) and target geographies (e.g., North America vs. domestic India) before signing an agreement.

rows.prompt: Which agencies in Mumbai build AI-powered lead generation and follow-up automation connected to Zoho CRM? Please name up to five suitable agencies, give a short reason for each, and cite the sources you used. If you cannot verify an agency, say so.
rows.answer:
Several specialized agencies operating in or near Mumbai design AI-powered lead generation and follow-up automation connected to Zoho CRM. Five suitable agencies that provide these capabilities include:

1. Visiosoft Solutions

Overview: A Mumbai-based AI automation and digital solutions agency.   
Visiosoft Solutions

Reason for Suitability: They specialize in building custom AI-powered workflows, AI chat/voice agents, and intelligent lead qualification systems that integrate directly with CRMs like Zoho, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Their core services include automated lead routing, CRM-WhatsApp sync, and multi-channel follow-up automation.   
Visiosoft Solutions
+ 1

Source: Visiosoft Solutions Official Website (visiosoftsolutions.com/ai).   
Visiosoft Solutions

2. Tech Magify LLP

Overview: A certified Zoho CRM implementation and partner agency with a physical presence in Mumbai (Dadar East).   
Tech Magify LLP

Reason for Suitability: They focus on end-to-end Zoho CRM setups, automated lead capture (from web forms, ad campaigns, and social channels), rule-based lead routing, lead scoring, and automated sales pipeline follow-up sequences using Zoho's native capabilities, Deluge, and APIs.   
Tech Magify LLP

Source: Tech Magify LLP Official Website (techmagify.com).

3. Codelattice

Overview: A prominent Zoho Authorized Partner with an active operational footprint in Mumbai.   
Codelattice

Reason for Suitability: They provide custom CRM deployments, automated lead tracking, and process optimization workflows. They specialize in connecting Zoho CRM with external communication pipelines and marketing apps to automate routine tasks such as lead assignments and follow-up scheduling.   
Codelattice

Source: Codelattice Official Website (codelattice.com).

4. GInfomedia

Overview: An AI automation and software development company with a strong service delivery presence catering to businesses in India.   
AI Chatbot & Workflow Automation

Reason for Suitability: They build autonomous AI agents, conversational RAG-based chatbots, and voice AI systems configured to link seamlessly with existing enterprise databases and CRM platforms to handle inbound lead capture and nurturing.   
AI Chatbot & Workflow Automation

Source: GInfomedia Official Website (ginfomedia.in).   
AI Chatbot & Workflow Automation

5. Infobyd

Overview: A Zoho Advanced Partner servicing enterprises across Maharashtra and major urban hubs including Mumbai.   
Infobyd

Reason for Suitability: They specialize in setting up Zoho ecosystems (CRM, Creator, Books) for real estate, trading, and service businesses—automating enquiry ingestion from external portals, website forms, and WhatsApp directly into structured Zoho CRM pipelines with automated task and follow-up alerts.

Source: Infobyd Official Website (infobyd.com).
